chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hajjal, from Ibn Sinan, who said:

My father wrote to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and he was making up the fast of the month of Ramadan, and said: 'I woke up in the morning with the washing (of major impurity), and sexual impurity struck me, so I did not perform the ritual bath until the dawn emerged.' So he (peace be upon him) answered him: 'Do not fast this day, and fast the next day.'

key_terms.لَا تَصُمْ: Do not fast (ruling of non-observance for that specific day)
key_terms.يَقْضِي: Making up (a missed obligation or fast)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one wakes up in a state of janabah after dawn in Ramadan?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that waking up in a state of major impurity (janabah) during Ramadan does not invalidate the fast, provided the person delays the ritual bath (ghusl) until after dawn. The ruling to 'fast tomorrow' indicates that the fast is valid but requires a makeup day (qada), reflecting the Shia view that the obligation to perform ghusl is separate from the validity of the fast itself. This highlights the scholarly distinction between the ritual purity required for prayer and the state of impurity at the time of dawn for fasting.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hajjal, from Ibn Sinan who said,

‘My father wrote to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and he was making up for the (Fast of the) Month of Ramazan, and said, ‘I woke up in the morning with the washing, the sexual impurity hit me, so I did not wash until the emergence of the dawn’. So he<sup>asws</sup> answered him: ‘Do not Fast this day, and Fast the next day’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Hajjal from ibn Sinan who has said the following: “

My father, once, when doing Qada’ (compensatory fast) of the fast of the month of Ramadan, wrote to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and asked, ‘I, up till the morning, had Ghusl (bath); then experienced sexual relation (because of which Ghusl (bath) is obligatory) and I did not do Ghusl (bath) until it was dawn. He (the Imam) said, ‘Do not fast that day, fast the next day.’”
